ListPreference.android:summary: Dark (default, light-green text) / light / follow system

SwitchPreference.android:title: Overlay bubble mode
SwitchPreference.android:summary: OFF by default. Turn ON to show the floating bubble. Recording is controlled via the notification bar either way.

ListPreference.android:title: Bubble size
ListPreference.android:summary: How big the quick-access bubble is

SwitchPreference.android:title: Record microphone
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Capture your voice via the mic (turn off for device audio only)

SwitchPreference.android:title: Noise suppression
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Reduce background noise while recording (Android 10+ recommended)

SwitchPreference.android:title: Echo cancellation
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Reduce echo from speakers while recording

SwitchPreference.android:title: Lock orientation
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Record in the current screen orientation without auto-rotating

SwitchPreference.android:summary: Show Start/Stop/Settings in the notification bar as soon as the app opens (ON by default). Works without the overlay bubble.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Show screenshot button
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Toggle the screenshot capture option in the bubble

SwitchPreference.android:title: Record streaming video (non-DRM)
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Enables capture of non-protected streams (Twitch, YouTube web, self-hosted)

SwitchPreference.android:title: Record DRM-protected content (experimental)
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Attempt to capture DRM-protected surfaces (Clapper, own content). May record blank on some apps.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Show tips
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Show a tip toast when recording starts (OFF by default)

Preference.android:title: About DRM-protected content
Preference.android:summary: Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ and other DRM apps cannot be recorded — the OS blocks capture at the hardware level.

Preference.android:summary: Copy the full error log so you can paste it to the developer.
